title: CY41011: Principles Of Organic Synthesis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: CY30103
Ideal synthesis; fundamentals of retrosynthesis, symmetry, stereochemistry,
conformation analysis, molecular mechanics, stereocontrol, ring formation,
reactivity, selectivity, catalysis, organometalic reactions. Functional group
transformations, umpolung and protecting groups.
Synthetic strategies and selected total syntheses
Textbook: M. B. Smith, Organic Synthesis. F. A. Carey and R. J Sundberg,
Advanced Organic Chemistry, Part B.
